title: Northside Coffee: a year in numbers

scenes.title: A year in numbers
scenes.subtitle: Northside Coffee · sample data
scenes.narration: Northside Coffee had a busy year. Here it is, told in numbers.

scenes.label: cups served
scenes.narration: We served just over forty-eight thousand cups, up twenty-two percent on last year.
Every quarter beat the last, and winter was the busiest of all.
Flat whites made up more than a third of every order.

scenes.heading: What we learned
points: Mornings drive two thirds of sales
scenes.narration: Three things stood out: busy mornings, the rise of oat milk, and the power of a loyalty card.

scenes.title: Here's to next year
scenes.narration: Thanks for a brilliant year. Here's to the next one.
